thread.title: Apple target cut at Morgan Stanley, BMO - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple target cut at Morgan Stanley, BMO - MarketWatch

organizations.name: et share emily bary reporter apple inc

text: Apple Inc. AAPL, -6.63% shares are down 6% in premarket trading Friday after the smartphone manufacturer posted better-than-expected September-quarter results but delivered a disappointing forecast for the holiday period and also announced that it would no longer be providing unit-sales figures as of its next report. Analysts at Morgan Stanley and BMO Capital Markets cut their price targets after the latest numbers hit. Morgan Stanley's Katy Huberty reduced her target to $226 from $247, citing multiple compression for other services companies as well as currency headwinds. She kept her overweight rating. BMO's Tim Long maintained his market perform rating and lowered his target to $213 from $219. "Management will no longer provide unit numbers, and some investors may be disappointed by the lower level of disclosures," he wrote. Apple shares have gained 32% over the past 12 months, as of Thursday's close, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.43% has gained 8%.
